label: Game A
nuance_found: Light-relay puzzle: turn bronze mirrors so a beam hits a stela crystal, and a lit mirror can relay to the next mirror, so mirror 1 must be aimed away from stela 1 to feed mirror 2 (stela stays lit once woken). Block push/pull also gates the beam path (pull the block out of the sunbeam). Only seen for about 100 s; I did not get mirror 2 lit.
audio: Ambient wind/drone loop with sequenced music stings at objective changes, a chord when stela 1 lit, noise bursts on interaction.
furthest_progress: Sunken Court: read expedition notes, pulled the stone block out of the sunbeam, turned mirror 1 to light stela 1 of 3; was trying to relay light to mirror 2 when the session died
control_trouble: Holding Use while steering often walked the character instead of turning the mirror; the screenshot was frequently black while Use was held; goto reported arrived while the character was still a couple of metres away. Phone then stopped returning frames.
best_moment: Stela 1 waking with a chord as the beam landed on its crystal.
worst_moment: Fighting the Use-plus-steer mirror control, then the phone going dark.
verdict: Handsome, clearly authored, with a real mechanism (aim mirrors, relay light, move blocks that occlude beams) that teaches itself through notes and hint cards. In 100 s I only saw one stela lit, so I cannot say whether the trade-offs deepen. Mirror turning felt fiddly on a touch stick. Not enough play to rate fairly.
